scoring_justification: Step 02 recomputes self-consistency (max differences) between HLM and RCWA from raw data; step 01 compares reported DE0 values to hidden gold from Table 1 (T0 acceptable). Overall tier is recompute because the load-bearing step uses T1.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for nonconical DE0 from Table 1
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table 1: first-order, second-order, higher-order and RCWA optimization values for TE and TM polarizations
hidden_assets.generation_method: typed from the paper's published table; verified against reference solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: directly copied from paper; not fabricated

schema.description: CSV with columns polarization (TE or TM), model_type (first_order, second_order, higher_order, RCWA), de0 (float, percent).

outputs.description: Nonconical zero-order backward diffraction efficiency DE0 for TE and TM polarizations computed with first-order, second-order, and higher-order indices. Checked against hidden reference values extracted from Table 1 of the paper within a tolerance.

schema.description: CSV with columns for λ/Λ and the HLM and RCWA results for TE component, TM component, total DE0, and relative phase (degrees).

outputs.description: Conical diffraction results: self-consistency between HLM and RCWA for TE-component, TM-component, total DE0, and relative phase at multiple λ/Λ values. The checker recomputes the maximum absolute difference between HLM and RCWA values across reported points and scores against a tolerance (<0.02 absolute for DE0, <10° for phase).

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the homogeneous-layer model (first-order, second-order, higher-order index formulas) and rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA) with at least 19 Fourier orders. The RCWA may be implemented from scratch or by using an open-source library. The output contract defines only the scored artifacts; no gold tolerances are revealed.
